author: kon333
body:
=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-= NewDawn LFM =-=-=-=-=-=-=-=

Hello, before I start I would like to point out that this team was previously known as BackSpace after the leader suddenly left i was assigned as leader, my goal is to take this team as far as possible as I will not be able to stay for long.

In the meantime we need members!


Minimum Requirements:

  • At least 12 hours game time on Avicus
  • You can follow instructions and carry them out willingly and sufficiently
  • You are relatively active for practise scrims and tournaments
  • You speak or understand English
Do not be put off by these requirments exceptions can be made if an excuse is acceptable.


The following format is how you should apply:

Timezone:
Discord: Example= Rockyyyyy#1111
Position: 
Do you have access to teamspeak and a working microphone you will use?
Past Experience:
Will you be active?
Extra Info:

Please be aware that this team will be scrimming alot so you need to be willing to progress and adabt quickly but at the end you will come out better.

We are not looking for PvP extraordinaires, just people willing to learn (wouldn't say no to a pvp god applying though :3) 

Anyways, Good Luck.
